## Capabilities

- One requested hygiene observation on a frozen exact candidate through a native, authenticated contact. Findings are validated independently; a rejected finding is waste, and a substantive Copilot-authored fix makes Copilot a material author ineligible to review that candidate.

- `github-copilot-lite-review`: One requested hygiene observation bound to a frozen exact candidate. Advisory evidence only; it cannot approve, merge, deploy, publish, change permissions, or waive deterministic evidence.
  - at most three conditional attempt slots; stop on success, recovery needs temporary failure, a third attempt needs materially new information or a different transport
  - live dispatch stays off until the primary activation gates pass
- `windows-host-provider-bridge`: GitHub Copilot is a supported host lane for its packet-wrapper command. Configuration alone never makes the lane callable, and production authority is refused regardless of the bridge.
  - child environment carries the base safe subset plus GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN only
- `browser-provider-ui`: GitHub Copilot is not among the charter's eligible browser providers; no browser coordination exists for this lane.
  - not in the charter's eligible browser providers
